title: Congo's Ebola outbreak passes 11,000 cases, second largest on record
caption:
Congo's Ebola outbreak has passed 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths, according to government data, making it the second largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine, and fighting in eastern Congo is slowing the response. The WHO has backed trials of two vaccine candidates.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
